sources.entry: Tabby (formerly Terminus) - Free terminal tool, built with TypeScript, heavily inspired by Hyper. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/Eugeny/terminus) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]
Tabby - Powerful cross-platform terminal emulator, featuring a modern GUI, and offering SSH, serial, Telnet, and SCP client support.

summary.one_liner: Tabby (formerly Terminus) is a configurable terminal emulator and SSH/serial client for Windows, macOS and Linux.
summary.what_it_does: Tabby is a terminal emulator with tabs and split panes, plus an integrated SSH and Telnet client with a connection manager. It includes a serial terminal with saved connections and optional hex input/output, and supports shells such as PowerShell, WSL, Git-Bash, Cygwin, MSYS2 and CMD. Files can be transferred over SSH sessions via Zmodem. The README also lists theming, configurable shortcuts, a Quake-style dropdown window, an encrypted store for SSH secrets, and an SSH/SFTP/Telnet web app that can be self-hosted. Plugins and themes can be installed from the Settings view.
use_cases: replace the default Windows or macOS terminal
manage multiple SSH connections in tabs
transfer files over SSH with Zmodem
run PowerShell, WSL or Git-Bash in one window
use a self-hosted SSH/SFTP web client
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the Downloads section of the README
Or use the Debian/Ubuntu or RPM package repositories listed in the README
Or download the latest nightly build
Windows portable mode: create a 'data' folder next to Tabby.exe
stack: Electron (implied by plugin and build docs; not named in README)
notable: Integrated SSH, Telnet, and serial clients in one terminal
Plugin system with installable plugins and themes from inside the app
Encrypted container for SSH secrets and configuration
Zmodem file transfer directly from SSH sessions
caveats: The README says Tabby is not lightweight; it recommends ConEmu or Alacritty if RAM usage matters
Windows-specific features such as Clink tab completion and Pageant support apply only to Windows
